summary.text: Laura Fine, a Democrat, has represented Illinois's 9th Senate District since 2018, after serving in the Illinois House from 2013 to 2018, according to the General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: The General Assembly biography says Fine holds a B.A. in telecommunications from Indiana University and an M.A. in political science from Northeastern Illinois University.
It lists Fine as a former journalist, a former instructor at Northeastern Illinois University and a former Northfield Township clerk, and says Fine is married with two children.
